name: Core Abstraction Triad
ascii:
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| H0 Core Abstraction Triad                                                                                         |
| Reusable center: other systems configure, transform, store, or interact with these three layers.                 |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

       +--------------------------------------+              +------------------------------------------+
       | POLICY + RECIPES                     |              | AGENT + PROMPT RUNTIME                   |
       | Configures all three core layers;    |              | Executes collection, generation, mapping|
       | it does not become a fourth layer.   |              | follow-up, and feedback-driven revision. |
       +------------------+-------------------+              +--------------------+---------------------+
                          | configures                                      | executes
                          +---------------------------+----------------------+
                                                      v
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
        | CORPUS                                                                                           |
        | Authoritative, addressable source of truth: identity, root, listing, and resource reads.        |
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
          | Corpus -> Evidence: Collect and Validate                    ^ Evidence -> Corpus: Resolve Anchors
          v                                                            |
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
        | EVIDENCE                                                                                         |
        | Immutable finalized semantic collection: labels, summaries, classifications, anchors, and       |
        | snapshots grounded in exact corpus ranges; no visual coordinates or workspace layout.           |
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
          | Evidence -> Representation: Generate and Ground             ^ Representation -> Evidence: Mapped Reveal
          v                                                            |
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
        | REPRESENTATION                                                                                   |
        | Revisioned visual projection of selected evidence; mappings connect visual spans to evidence    |
        | and source ranges, and grounding always resolves through EVIDENCE.                               |
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
        +---- Representation -> Representation: Refine Revision ------------------------------------------+
        | Refine, expand, derive, or edit a further artifact-scoped revision without replacing grounding. |
        +--------------------------------------< next revision <-------------------------------------------+

        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
        | Evidence-Only Grounding Bridge                                                                   |
        | CORPUS - - - - - - - - - X  NO DIRECT REPRESENTATION GROUNDING  X - - - - - - REPRESENTATION   |
        | Required reveal path: REPRESENTATION -> EVIDENCE -> CORPUS                                      |
        | Representation refinement cannot replace this grounding contract.                               |
        +--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

                         ^ persists / reloads                           ^ interaction / feedback
                         |                                             |
       +-----------------+--------------------+       +----------------+---------------------------+
       | PERSISTENCE + PROVENANCE             |       | WORKSPACE + API                            |
       | Bidirectionally stores core bindings,|       | Bidirectional with EVIDENCE and            |
       | collections, artifacts, mappings,    |       | REPRESENTATION; CORPUS access is limited   |
       | graphs, highlights, and ownership.   |       | to explicit browsing or resolved reads.    |
       +--------------------------------------+       +--------------------------------------------+
